correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 and t>0 a weighted Laplacian cofactor splits into an n-2 dimensional scalar eigenvalue and a residual 2x2 determinant. Its explicit factorization gives a valid independent Bin(n-2,p)+Bern(q) rooted-degree law. Direct differentiation gives a fixed-mean convex expectation derivative with sign opposite t-1; strictness is established for variance and leaves. Binomial pgf convergence gives the claimed full local crossover. Replayed standard-library exact verifier: 212 assertions, independently including exhaustive all-tree enumeration for n<=4. The finite checks do not replace the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The fixed perfect-matching fugacity is a canonical deformation of a vertex-transitive dense network. The result classifies the *whole* local-degree law in convex order (not just the mean), gives unique exact leaf and variance optimizers for every finite n>=3, and detects a novel Poisson-plus-Bernoulli local crossover on the intrinsic t~n scale. The continuum of parameter comparisons and sharp boundary behavior are structurally motivated, not an isolated small invariant.
